mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above a 3% quarter-over-quarter growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS QoQ > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5% and FEDFUNDS > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1.2M and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) growth is positive and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a supply-side driven recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO QoQ > 0% and GDPC1 QoQ < 0%.
